profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Datadog
profile.summary:
Lead engineer who raises the engineering bar. Turns stuck situations into repeatable wins: clarifying scope when stakeholders disagree, establishing practices that outlast projects, and building platforms that make the right thing the easy thing. Specializes in developer effectiveness, data systems, and taking initiatives from customer 0 to org-wide adoption.

Keywords
Ghostty, Neovim, Claude Code, Cursor Agent; Languages & Frameworks: Golang, Python, HTTP, gRPC; Distributed & Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka; Build & Delivery: Bazel, Docker, CMake, Jenkins, Gitlab, Bitbucket; Infra & Automation: Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm/CDK8s, Temporal

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enable AI product engineers to spend less time crafting evals by delivering low- and high- fidelity synthetic data and simulations. Includes research on algorithmic techniques and autonomous coding agent designs.

- Give every team visibility into data quality (resilience, completeness, and correctness) across billions of requests and trillions of events / day by bringing software verification techniques (metamorphic testing, fuzzing, deterministic simulation) into production observability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
"Metrics Query: Technical lead for queries through Datadog's core Metrics product.

- Guided a team stuck in private beta for 6+ months into production launch (https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/nested-queries/).

- Raised the engineering baseline–coding, debugging, and pager practices–as the team doubled

- Be the glue for cross-functional, cross-product stakeholders to re-evaluate query behavior to build better products and benefit our customers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
"API Platform" group:  Founding engineer for Datadog’s batteries-included internal developer platform

- Scaled from customer 0 to hundreds of internal adopters by measuring feedback loops and obsessing over migration pain.

- Enabled dozens of new products to launch faster with consistent access to Datadog platform capabilities (API standards, managed services, local development, CI/CD)

- Grew early Bazel investment into company-wide infrastructure, becoming the internal expert and driving it to the next level of scale by emphasizing the basics and lowering integration friction across teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
“Audience”: Identifying and segmenting over a billion users across devices, integrating with data from partners, and activating its use in Xandr’s real-time digital ad serving platform. 

C++, Protobuf, Aerospike, Kafka, MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: “Platform, DevOps”: Small, high-leverage team enabling product engineers to ship safely. Maintained ephemeral test environments, reproducible builds and packaging, and phased rollouts across 100+ services and thousands of machines with uptime-aware deployment orchestration.

educations.schoolName: Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology
